note: Park in the lot just over the bridge on NY Route 167 in Little Falls: take the first drive on the right after crossing the river and park right under the bridge.
basis: Leatherstocking Botanical Society Moss Island event page (flnps.org/node/973): 'parking area off of NY Rt 167', 'entry being just over the bridge over the river, the first drive to the right', 'You actually park right under the bridge.' 2016 page; MP had no parking text.

note: Park on the east side of the road at the large dirt turn-out at County Road 104 and Utah 211, then go through the ranch gate (close it) and follow a trail northeast, almost 2 miles. A capable 2WD may drive closer; conditions may have changed.
basis: Mountain Project Cat Wall (Indian Creek): 'Park on the east side of the road at the large dirt turn-out', hike almost 2 miles through ranch gate; 2WD may drive closer and park on a knoll.

note: Turn onto Whippoorwill Road just off US-19 near the bridge, follow it right and downhill, and park at the pullout on the more obvious second dirt road on the left. If full, park fully off the road; do not use the gravesite parking.
basis: thetopo.com Whippoorwill: 'Whippoorwill Road is the 2nd road on your left', 'a second, more obvious road with a parking pullout', 'If it's full, you can parallel park along the side of the road, keeping your car 100% off the road', 'Don't park in the gravesite parking'. rockclimbing.com (search summary only; fetch failed) agreed: dirt road with parking at entrance.

note: Park at the Seneca Rocks visitor center lots (upper or lower; lower is closer) just south on US 33, then hike up Roy Gap Road to the creek crossing with the stone stairs on the far side, which leads up to the West Face.
basis: Mountain Project Seneca Rocks: 'All routes on the South Peak or Southern Pillar start by hiking up Roy Gap Road from the visitor's center', 'You can park at the upper or lower lots (lower is closer)', visitor center 'just south on US Route 33'; MP South Peak West Face page (search summary): signpost on Roy Gap Road, cross stream, stone staircase.

note: Park at the intersection of Reeds Creek Road with Route 220 near Upper Tract, or in one of two small pull-outs on the left of Reeds Creek Road (about 100 ft and 500 ft in, 2-3 cars each). Parking is limited and can fill; do not park outside the obvious spots.
basis: Potomac Mountain Club Reeds Creek: 'Parking can be found at the intersection of Reed's Creek Rd with Rt 220', 'two small pull-outs on the left side... Both can take 2-3 cars', 'not unknown for the parking to be full', 'Please do not park outside the obvious areas.'

note: Drive from Cashiers via US 64, Cedar Creek Road and Breedlove Road to the Panthertown Valley trailhead lot at Salt Rock Gap, where the gravel road ends. This trailhead is the only legal access; do not approach from Dillard Canyon (private).
basis: Mountain Project Laurel Knob: 'The road changes to gravel and ends in the Panthertown trailhead parking lot'; Carolina Climbers Coalition: 'Parking and access are via Panthertown Valley at the Salt Rock Trailhead.' 'Do not hike in from Dillard Canyon, it is private property.'

note: The crag is on South 5th Ave in Pocatello, below the Fort Hall Replica and Upper Ross Park. Park at the north or south end of the park; the road is busy, so watch kids and dogs.
basis: MP Shady Side (East Idaho): "The Shady Side is located on South 5th Ave. in Pocatello... Park at the north or south end of the park. This crag is right on a busy road". Second search snippet: park along S. 5th Street or take the S. 5th access to parking within Ross Park.

note: The Overlook is on the east side of Highway 89A at the top of Oak Creek Canyon, just before the switchbacks. Use the paved lot, but if staying past 4:30 pm park across the highway because the gates are locked then.
basis: MP Oak Creek Canyon Overlook (fetched): "You can park in the paved lot, but if you plan on staying later than 4:30 in the afternoon, you will want to park across the Hwy, as they lock the Overlook gates at that time."

note: Flatrock, about 20 minutes north of St. John's: park in the East Coast Trail lot just past the public wharf. Parking on Wade's Lane is no longer permitted, so use the designated lots only.
basis: MP Flatrock (fetched): "for all other areas you can park at the East Coast Trail lot just past the public wharf... Parking on Wade's Lane is no longer permitted, upon request of the town of Flatrock". Main Face identified as Flatrock via search results (rockclimbing.com Newfoundland/Flatrock/Main_Face).

note: Hospital Boulders: park in the gated lot on the climber-owned property off Scenic Highway in Gadsden, then walk past the barn on the narrow entry road to a trail trending downhill. The property is open dawn to dusk only; the gate combination is shared by the local climbing group.
basis: MP Barn Area: "Continue in the same direction as the narrow entry road, past the barn, forward to an obvious trail that trends slightly downhill." MP Hospital Boulders: "The parking lot is gated and the lock combination is available through the SCC website." SCC page: "only open from dawn til dusk", boulder field a few hundred feet from the lot. Barn-specific lot not named.

note: Hospital Boulders: park in the gated lot on the climber-owned property off Scenic Highway in Gadsden, then walk past the barn and follow the trail downhill and right. The property is open dawn to dusk only; the gate combination is shared by the local climbing group.
basis: MP Barn Area: "Continue right and downhill to make it to the Eddie Area or the Lower Area." MP Hospital Boulders: "The parking lot is gated and the lock combination is available through the SCC website." SCC: open dawn til dusk. Eddie-specific parking not given.
